a: US$75,000 per year in total, usually three grants of US$25,000
dt: 22 Mar 2027, 11:59 pm Paris time (UTC+1); reference letters must also arrive by then
e: Grant toward a postdoctoral appointment for early-career astronomers in any area of astrophysics, within three years of the PhD defence (final-year PhD students with a confirmed postdoc contract may apply). The host institution must be in a different country from the PhD institution (or from the previous postdoc institution); no nationality limits.
